Varga is an [[NPCs (Silksong)|NPC]] in [[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]. He is a member of the [[Flea Caravan]].

== In-game Events ==
Varga can initially be found in [[the Marrow]] with the rest of the Flea Caravan. He finds this location cozy and is reluctant to move on.

After the Flea Caravan moves to [[Greymoor]], Varga can be found resting inside one of the carts, sheltering from the rain.

According to [[Grishkin]], Varga is nearly eaten by [[Sandcarver|Sandcarvers]] during the move to the [[Blasted Steps]], but is ultimately able to make it there safely. At the Blasted Steps, Varga can be seen in the background near the pot of [[Flea Brew]], but cannot be interacted with at this location.

When the Flea Caravan moves to [[Putrified Ducts]] and forms [[Fleatopia]], Varga stays at east side of the camp away from the fleas, and can be interacted with again.

During the [[Festival of the Flea]] he can be seen sitting in the background with the other fleas. He can rarely appear during [[Flea Juggle]] donning a copper helmet, replacing a normal Flea.

== Location ==
Varga can be encountered along with the [[Flea Caravan]] at either [[the Marrow]], [[Greymoor]], [[Blasted Steps]] or [[Fleatopia]], depending on the amount of Fleas found.
